title: holding
_what: ⛔ SNG-658 §2 — A PLACE THAT IS YOURS, in `character.holdings`. It has a condition that drifts, a keeper who holds the floor under it, things built on it, and people at it.
_derivedFrom: The live saves, 2026-09-26; each field's description says how often it is present.

^_._what: a note or a provenance stamp

runs.description: SNG-665 (CCODE-564): the hold's standing trade runs, each asking for units a pass; allocatePass splits a pass between the upkeep reserve, the runs and selling at home.

clearing.description: SNG-666 (CCODE-565): ground being cleared (or a frame built out) at this hold: budget, progress, passes.

spotsCleared.description: SNG-666: feature spots this hold has cleared by work; roomOf adds them to its rung's room.

frameRaised.description: SNG-666 §2.1: how many more features a MOVING hold's frame carries than its kind allows — raised by a clearing job finished on the frame (holdings.js: 'a frame is raised by engineering, not by growth'), never by growth. Written by the engine since CCODE-565; declared the day Loki's save first carried one (CCODE-640).

kind.description: 100% — post · steading · hamlet · village · town · keep … which sets the spots it has and what it costs to keep.

locationId.description: 100% — where it stands. Null for a hull under way.

steward.description: 100% — ⛔ the person KEEPING it: a delegate who stays at the hold, which is why they are not in your travelling company. They set the condition floor it will not drop below.

obligation.description: 100% — what you owe for it, when it was not simply taken.

condition.description: 100% — failing · strained · holding · thriving. ⚠️ `failed` is the QUEST vocabulary and has no meaning here.

lastMovedWorldCount.description: 100% — when its condition last drifted, in world hours.

history.description: 100% — every condition change and every event, newest last.

garrison.description: 83% — person ids standing watch. ⛑ This is what SEES a raid coming; stone alone does not see.

trade.description: 100% — whether it is open to trade.

stock.description: ✅ SNG-652 §6 — THE STOCK POLICY: what the keeper does with what the place makes. `all` is the store's, `goods` is per good and wins over it. Absent is "sell what she can each pass", which is what every hold did before this existed. ⛑ It is not a share and not a price: `keeperSells` says how much she CAN move in a pass, this says how much she is ALLOWED to, and `sellPlanFor` composes the two.

all.description: one policy: `keepAll` · `keepUpTo` with `keep` units held back · `sellAll`.

keep.description: units held back; read only for `keepUpTo`.

additionalProperties.description: one policy: `keepAll` · `keepUpTo` with `keep` units held back · `sellAll`.

keep.description: units held back; read only for `keepUpTo`.

route.description: ✅ SNG-654 A (Erik: "yes on a-d") — the STANDING RUN out of this hold: where it goes, who walks it, and how many times it has been walked. While it stands its keeper holds the stock back for the cart instead of selling it here (`sellShareFor` reads this), and `runStandingRoutes` sends the next load whenever the crew is home.

toId.description: the place the run goes to.

setDay.description: the world day the run was set.

lastDepartureDay.description: the world day the last load left.

growthPasses.description: 100% — how many passes it has grown for.

imageSeedKey.description: 100% — the seed that picture was drawn from.

imagePinned.description: 100% — the player has fixed that picture.

describedAs.description: 67% — the GM's own line about it.

lastFeatureOfferCount.description: 67% — when it was last offered something to build.

fromAssignment.description: 33% — the delegated work it came out of.

watches.description: 17% — what it keeps an eye on.

carriage.description: 17% — for a hull: how it moves and where it is on its voyage.

notFeature.description: feature kinds the player has said this place does NOT have, so the reader stops offering them. Written by `answerFeatureOffer` (holdings.js) and read back by the same function before it offers. ⚠️ Undeclared until 2026-09-30 — it does not exist on a hold until somebody declines an offer, so the census could not see it until Erik declined a shrine at the Standing Annex.

arrearsWhy.description: what the arrears are FOR, newest last — `{ n, why, day }`, at most six. Written only by `oweIt`, cleared as `payArrears` pays the oldest off first. Erik, on seeing a bare number: "not sure, because I can't seem to do anything about it."

n.description: how much of the debt this reason accounts for.

why.description: the reason in the hold's own words — "couldn't pay the stall at Millbrook".

day.description: the day it was owed, when the tick knew one.

conditionSince.description: 17% — the day it entered its current condition.

gear.description: Which gear the armory is working (a key of `rules.economy.armory.gear`).

left.description: How many of them are still to be made.

forgeOrder.description: A standing order at this hold's armory (CCODE-445, `armory.js`): the makers work it a pass at a time out of the store's raw material until `left` reaches zero.
